key_terms.الْكُفْرِ: disbelief; rejection of faith and divine truth
key_terms.اَلِارْتِيَابُ: doubt, misgiving, or inner uncertainty in matters of religion

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about doubt in religion?
ai.summary: This concise prophetic saying identifies religious doubt and wavering certainty as belonging to kufr. It highlights the theological importance of firm conviction in matters of faith and warns against allowing skepticism to take root in religion.
